scope: Additive onboarding request queue for portal User & Access create/invite/assign workflow.

tables.name: OnboardingRequests
tables.purpose: Durable request queue row created by the portal and processed by Dataverse-triggered automation.

columns.name: RequestKey
columns.notes: Stable idempotency key generated by the portal.

columns.name: RequestId
columns.notes: User-facing request id shown in the portal result panel.

columns.name: Status
columns.notes: Processing status. Codes: Pending=100000000, Processing=100000001, Completed=100000002, Failed=100000003, Cancelled=100000004, NeedsReview=100000005.

columns.name: RequestType
columns.notes: Target user classification. Codes: NewUser=100000000, ExistingUser=100000001, Unresolved=100000002.

columns.name: FullName
columns.notes: Requested user full name.

columns.name: Email
columns.notes: Normalized primary email used for contact lookup and assignment matching.

columns.name: TargetRole
columns.notes: Requested TACATDP role label.

columns.name: ProjectId
columns.notes: Project identifier snapshot. Lookup can replace this after the platform project schema is finalized.

columns.name: ProjectName
columns.notes: Project display-name snapshot for operator readability.

columns.name: FormScopeJson
columns.notes: JSON array of selected form and form-version identifiers.

columns.name: Reason
columns.notes: Business reason entered by the administrator.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.notes: Signed-in administrator email.

columns.name: ActorRolesJson
columns.notes: Detected administrator web-role snapshot.

columns.name: SourceRoute
columns.notes: Portal route/action source, for example UserAccess:AddUser.

columns.name: ContactId
columns.notes: Resolved Power Pages contact id written by automation.

columns.name: ProcessingAttempts
columns.notes: Number of server-side processing attempts. Defaults to 0.

columns.name: LastAttemptAt
columns.notes: Last server-side processing attempt timestamp.

columns.name: CompletedAt
columns.notes: Completion timestamp when status is Completed.

columns.name: ResultMessage
columns.notes: Business-readable status or failure message.

columns.name: ErrorCategory
columns.notes: Sanitized category for failure handling.

columns.name: ErrorJson
columns.notes: Sanitized structured error. Must not include secrets or raw invitation URLs.

columns.name: AuditKey
columns.notes: Access audit event key written by automation after audit create succeeds.

columns.name: InvitationId
columns.notes: Power Pages invitation id written by automation when a new-user invitation is created.

columns.name: InvitationCode
columns.notes: Invitation code for approved manual/verbal fallback. Expose only to Platform Administrator request readers.

columns.name: InvitationRedeemUrl
columns.notes: Portal invitation redemption URL without credentials or bearer tokens.

columns.name: InvitationExpiresAt
columns.notes: Invitation expiry timestamp used to decide whether a replacement invitation is required.

columns.name: InvitationStatus
columns.notes: Invitation lifecycle. Codes: Pending=100000000, ManualDeliveryRequired=100000001, EmailSent=100000002, Redeemed=100000003, Expired=100000004, Replaced=100000005.

columns.name: InvitationDeliveryMode
columns.notes: Delivery route. Codes: Email=100000000, ManualCode=100000001, AssignmentNotification=100000002.

columns.name: ReplacementOfRequestId
columns.notes: Original request id when an administrator creates a replacement invitation after expiry or loss.

alternate_keys.name: ak_onboarding_request_key
alternate_keys.notes: Prevents duplicate queue rows for the same administrator operation.
